parallels.note: “ ‘These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the…
All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures…
Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

translations.web: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.
translations.bsb: Of all the creatures that live in the water, you may eat anything with fins and scales,
translations.kjv: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
translations.asv: These ye may eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales may ye eat;
